claims.subject: Thompson-Okanagan Transit Ltd.
claims.finding: Formerly Tweed Line Tours Ltd.; a wholly owned subsidiary in the T.S. Holdings consolidation.
claims.limits: The note gives no effective rename date.

claims.subject: Vancouver Island Transit Ltd.
claims.finding: Formerly McArthur Transportation Limited; a wholly owned subsidiary in the T.S. Holdings consolidation.
claims.limits: The note gives no effective rename date. This is distinct from Vancouver Island Transportation Company Limited.

claims.subject: V I T Holdings five-company group
claims.finding: V I T Holdings owns 98.24% of each of the five named companies directly or through a subsidiary.
claims.limits: Snapshot, not an acquisition or percentage-change date; immediate parent unresolved for four of the five.

claims.subject: V I T Holdings five-company group
claims.finding: V I T Holdings owns 98.4% of each of the five named companies directly or through a subsidiary.
claims.limits: Snapshot, not an acquisition or percentage-change date; immediate parent unresolved for four of the five.

claims.subject: V I T Holdings five-company group
claims.finding: V I T Holdings owns 98.5% of each of the five named companies directly or through a subsidiary.
claims.limits: Snapshot, not an acquisition or percentage-change date; immediate parent unresolved for four of the five.

claims.subject: V I T Holdings Ltd. / Vancouver Island Transportation Company Limited
claims.finding: The 1976 and 1977 goodwill notes name V I T Holdings as acquirer of Vancouver Island Transportation; the 1978 note identifies Transportation as its subsidiary; the 1979 note identifies Holdings as seller of the Transportation shareholding.
claims.limits: These statements do not establish the original acquisition date.

claims.subject: Vancouver Island Transportation Company Limited
claims.finding: V I T Holdings sold its 98.5% holding to the Province of British Columbia.
claims.limits: Share transfer, separate from the subsequent asset/liability transaction; not 100%.

claims.subject: V I T Holdings Ltd.
claims.finding: V I T Holdings was liquidated.
claims.limits: The passage does not establish the registry dissolution date.

claims.subject: T.S. Holdings Ltd. subsidiaries
claims.finding: The consolidated wholly owned subsidiary list contains Thompson-Okanagan Transit Ltd. and Vancouver Island Transit Ltd.; subsidiaries sold or liquidated during the year were accounted for to their respective disposal dates.
claims.limits: Do not extend the earlier three-subsidiary observation through 31 March 1979.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines Limited, company 178561
claims.finding: Pacific Coach Lines Limited was incorporated under the British Columbia Companies Act.
claims.limits: The corporate note does not identify the initial shareholder or subscription date.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines Limited, company 178561
claims.finding: Pacific Coach Lines purchased Vancouver Island Transportation Company Limited assets, assumed its liabilities, and commenced operations.
claims.limits: An asset/liability transfer; no legal merger, dissolution, rename or purchase of subsidiaries shares is established.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines Limited, company 178561
claims.finding: Pacific Coach Lines acquired certain assets and operating responsibilities of Pacific Stage Lines, a division of British Columbia Hydro and Power Authority.
claims.limits: This later transfer is not the legal incorporation or first operational start of Pacific Coach.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines Limited, company 178561
claims.finding: The Province held the entire issued capital stock of two common shares.
claims.limits: The schedule confirms the snapshot; it does not by itself date the initial subscription.

claims.subject: T.S. Holdings Ltd.
claims.finding: The Province held the entire issued capital stock of one common share.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines Limited, company 178561
claims.finding: Pacific Coach Lines Limited changed name to 178561 B.C. Ltd.
claims.limits: Publication was 2 August 1990. The notice does not establish ownership in 1990 or a privatization or dissolution date.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines (1984) Ltd., company 273925
claims.finding: The Gazette identifies this separate company as incorporated on 7 February 1984.
claims.limits: No ownership relationship with the original Crown company is established by this notice.

claims.subject: Pacific Coach Lines (1984) Ltd., company 273925
claims.finding: Pacific Coach Lines (1984) Ltd. changed name to 273925 B.C. Ltd.
claims.limits: Publication was 2 August 1990. Distinct legal identity from company 178561.

claims.subject: Royal Victorian Holdings Corporation, company 362538
claims.finding: The Gazette identifies Royal Victorian Holdings Corporation as incorporated on 29 March 1989.
claims.limits: No Crown ownership or acquisition relationship is established by the notice.

claims.subject: Royal Victorian Holdings Corporation, company 362538
claims.finding: Royal Victorian Holdings Corporation changed name to Pacific Coach Lines Ltd.
claims.limits: Publication was 2 August 1990. Distinct legal identity from companies 178561 and 273925.

supersessions.source_preservation: Retain the Hydro report as a source-specific description of 1979 service replacement; the company accounts establish earlier legal creation and first operations.
supersessions.unaffected_scope: The earlier 31 March 1984 operations-cessation claim was not reverified here; retain its separate source and do not turn it into a dissolution date.

graph_recommendations: Add the two former-name relationships as aliases observed by 31 March 1976; leave exact rename dates unknown.
Preserve decimal ownership values: 98.24 in 1976, 98.4 in 1977, 98.5 in 1978. Do not round to 98 or backdate 98.5 across every year.
Treat the annual ownership statements as observations. If visual continuity between them is inferred, label that inference.
For the other four V I T group companies, do not invent an immediate parent. Use a qualified indirect relationship or retain the evidence in the roster until the graph can represent it.
End V I T Holdings ownership of Vancouver Island Transportation at 24 July 1978 and record the Province as 98.5% acquirer on that date.
Record V I T Holdings liquidation on 22 January 1979. Keep registry dissolution unknown and exclude it from the continuing T.S. consolidated subsidiaries at 31 March 1979.
Preserve Vancouver Island Transit, Vancouver Island Transportation and Vancouver Island Coach Lines as distinct entities.
Correct Pacific Coach incorporation and first operations to August 1978; retain April 1979 as the Pacific Stage transfer.
Keep the Province ownership snapshot at 31 March 1979 distinct from the incorporation event; exact initial subscription date is not in these notes.
Key Pacific Coach legal identities by company numbers 178561, 273925 and 362538. Name changes do not prove ownership, privatization or dissolution.
